title: Kalol Youth Team Wins at National Youth Festival
excerpt: The dance group ‘We Almighty’ secured third place nationally, with Megh Foundation supporting travel and on-ground coordination.
coverImageAlt: Youth performers celebrating after competition result
bodyMarkdown:
## A proud moment for local youth

At the National Youth Festival organized under NYKS and the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Kalol's youth dance team *We Almighty* secured third prize among top teams from across India.

## Megh Foundation's role

Megh Foundation supported the team through travel assistance and hand-holding so talent was not limited by logistics.

## Impact beyond one event

This achievement has encouraged more young people in the city to pursue performing arts with confidence and discipline. It also reinforces the importance of local institutions that invest in youth potential at the right time.
